Error codes, permission checks and argument validation order are not shown.
State transition preconditions, sequencing and side effects beyond value definitions are not shown.
Capability chain iteration, version negotiation and compatibility handling are not shown.

findings.text: These fragments export user space contracts for device passthrough: region description, selective mapping, interrupt description and programming, reset, graphics display and planes, event notification, generic features, external page table binding, migration, power, dirty tracking, and input output memory management mapping.

A region descriptor conveys total buffer length, a flag word, a numeric selector, a byte displacement to the first capability record, an aligned byte length, and an aligned displacement from the start of the device file. Flags signal readability, writability, mappability, and presence of capabilities.
Region access flags use decimal one for read, two for write, four for mmap, and eight for capability support.
Region description is retrieved through the device file operation at base displacement eight, taking and returning the region descriptor sized by its leading length.

Sparse mapping describes selective mappable subranges. A common header is followed by an area count plus reserved space, then a flexible tail of area records. Each area pairs an aligned displacement inside the region with an aligned length, permitting unimplemented holes between entries.
Region capability identifiers are one for sparse mapping, two for type, three for MSI-X mappable, four for NVLink address target, and five for NVLink link speed.

A type capability pairs a common header with a bus global type value and a type specific subtype value. Companion NVLink capabilities reuse the common header: one carries an aligned target address, the other carries a link speed value plus padding.

Region types use one for graphics, two for channel I/O, three for deprecated migration, and high bit set for PCI vendor specific with low sixteen bits as vendor mask. Subtypes use one for display data, NVLink memory, translation service, async command and deprecated migration; two for host config and measurement block; three for bridge config and alert record.

Graphics display data conveys a display byte offset, a maximum capacity, a current size, maximum horizontal and vertical limits, and a link indication. Link uses one for connected and two for disconnected. Offset plus maximum bound the writable area while current size reports present bytes.

Deprecated migration state holds a state word, a reserved word, and three aligned quantities for outstanding bytes, data window displacement, and data window length. State bits use zero for stopped, one for running, two for saving, and four for resuming, with combined mask seven.

Deprecated migration validity requires that when resume is present the masked state equals resume alone. Simultaneous saving and resuming encodes error. Entering error preserves bits outside the mask while forcing both saving and resuming bits, yielding exclusive save versus resume with explicit error.

Interrupt description carries total length, flag word, group selector, and vector count within the group. Flags denote event file support, maskability, automatic masking on delivery, and fixed count. Its query uses base displacement nine.

Interrupt programming carries total length, flag word, group selector, start vector, vector count, and a flexible tail whose meaning depends on data kind. Data kinds select absent, byte booleans, or event descriptors; actions select mask, unmask, or synthetic trigger. Configuration uses base displacement ten.

Interrupt description values use one, two, four, eight for event file, maskable, auto masked, no resize. Programming values use one for no data, two for boolean, four for event file, eight for mask, sixteen for unmask, thirty two for trigger. Data mask combines to seven and action mask to fifty six.

PCI region selectors run zero through five for address windows, six for expansion ROM, seven for config, eight for VGA, with nine as fixed count. PCI interrupts run zero legacy, one message, two extended message, three error, four request. Channel I/O has one region and three interrupts; matrix has two interrupts with count after.

Hot reset discovery reports total length, flag word, dependent count, and flexible tail of dependent locations. Each dependent shares a slot for either group identity or device identity plus segment, bus, and slot function addressing. Owned uses zero and foreign uses negative one; request flags use one for identifier form and two to require owned form. Discovery uses displacement twelve.

Hot reset execution carries total length, flag word, count, and flexible tail of group descriptors, invoked at displacement thirteen. Single device reset is a bare operation at displacement eleven with no payload.

Graphics plane query carries total length, flag word, requested plane category on entry, and on exit format, modifier, dimensions, stride, byte size, cursor placement and hotspot, plus a shared slot for either region selector or buffer handle. Type probe uses one for probe, two for shared buffer, four for region. Query uses fourteen and buffer retrieval uses fifteen.

Event notification binding carries total length, flag word, aligned device displacement, aligned compare payload, signed descriptor with negative one meaning release, and reserved space. Width uses one for one byte, two for two bytes, four for four bytes, eight for eight bytes, mask fifteen. Binding uses displacement sixteen.

Generic feature transport carries total length, flag word, and flexible data tail. Low sixteen bits select feature index with mask sixty five thousand five hundred thirty five; higher bits select get, set, and probe with values sixty five thousand five hundred thirty six, one hundred thirty one thousand seventy two, and two hundred sixty two thousand one hundred forty four. Transport uses displacement seventeen.

External table binding carries total length, flag word, signed manager descriptor, output device identifier, and aligned token pointer; token use is flagged by one at displacement eighteen. Attachment carries total length, flag word, table identifier and address space identifier with optional flag one at nineteen. Detachment carries total length, flag word and address space identifier with matching flag at twenty.

Feature selectors use zero for virtual function token, one for migration, two for migration state, three for low power entry, four for low power entry with wake, five for low power exit, six for dirty start, seven for dirty stop, eight for dirty report, nine for migration size, ten for bus mastering, eleven for shared buffer, twelve for precopy v2, thirteen for platform PCI error.

Migration capability bits use one for stop copy, two for peer, four for precopy. Bus master operations use zero for clear and one for set. Precopy reinit output uses one. Token, attach and detach option flags each use one.

Migration capability holds aligned flags. Migration state holds a state selector plus signed data descriptor. Precopy progress reports total length, flags, initial and dirty counts, queried at twenty one. Dirty control conveys page size, range count, reserved word and range pointer; each range pairs base and length. Dirty report conveys base, length, page size and bitmap pointer. Size report holds stop copy length. Master record holds operation. Buffer sharing holds region, open flags, flags, count and flexible offset length tail. Platform error holds aligned payload. Wake entry holds signed event descriptor plus reserved.

Modern migration states enumerate zero error, one stopped, two running, three stop copy, four resuming, five running with peer, six precopy, seven precopy with peer, eight as count sentinel. Error is distinct from stopped; peer variants extend running and precopy; stop copy bridges running toward terminal save.

Memory management description carries total length, flag word, aligned supported page bitmap, capability offset and padding. Flags use one for page validity and two for capability support. Capability one chains count plus reserved and flexible start end spans. Capability two adds flags, page bitmap and maximum dirty size. Capability three adds available size. Query uses twelve on the management file.

Mapping carries total length, flags, process address, device address and byte length; flags use one for device readable, two for writable, four for virtual address form, at thirteen. Unmapping carries total length, flags, device address, length and flexible tail; flags use one for dirty retrieval, two for whole domain, four for virtual address form, at fourteen. Bitmap conveys page size, byte length and user pointer with one bit per page.

Dirty control carries total length, flags and flexible tail; flags use one for start, two for stop, four for fetch, at seventeen. Fetch pairs device address and length with embedded bitmap. Enable and disable are bare operations at fifteen and sixteen. Platform table description carries total length, flags, window base and size, plus nested page bitmap, dynamic window limit and level count; dynamic support uses one, queried at twelve.

Leading total length governs versioning and flexible tails: callers set available bytes and implementations validate before touching trailing records. Capability offsets are byte displacements from the same buffer start with zero meaning absent. Counts size following arrays, reserved words stay zero, and aligned fields preserve layout across word sizes.

PCI graphics compatibility exposes legacy port and frame spans at identity displacement from the region base with gaps unimplemented. PCI region count nine and interrupt counts are fixed contracts; higher selectors are interpreted through device specific type capabilities rather than extending the fixed table.

Flexible tails, shared slots and caller pointers need strict checks: counts and lengths must bound area, device, descriptor, range and bitmap arrays; union choice between group versus device identity and region versus buffer handle must match flags or probe outcome; bitmap and token pointers reference caller memory; reused displacements across device versus management files need file context to disambiguate.

Device operations occupy displacements eight through twenty one for region, interrupt query, interrupt config, reset, hot reset discovery, hot reset, graphics plane, graphics buffer, event notification, generic feature, table bind, attach, detach and precopy. Management reuses twelve through seventeen for info, map, unmap, enable, disable and dirty control, plus a platform info query at twelve.
